notes: The horror mods actually do things now. Corner Entity comes about every 15 minutes instead of once in eight hours, with faces in the corner of your screen every 5.
The Man From The Shadow starts on your first day instead of the third: its Stalker watches from the start, the Man can come from day 1, and the Stalker hunts you from day 2.
The Starved Stalker comes about every 5 minutes of night or underground, Playmate wants to play after just one night awake, and the giant spiders come more often in the dark.
